_comments._how_to_use: JSON has no comments, so they live here; the job ignores this block. Copy this file to config/settings.json, replace every <placeholder>, then run tools/generate_inventory.py. Only names and secret references go here, never passwords. Do not add '_comment' keys inside other sections: table_properties keys become real table properties and manifest.columns rejects unknown keys.
_comments.inventory_version: Free label for this table list, e.g. wave_001. Change it whenever tables are added or changed; it is recorded with every run.
_comments.source_set_id: Name of the upstream data set. Part of the write guard on every target table: set once, never change it later.
_comments.synapse.server: Synapse workspace SQL endpoint, e.g. myws.sql.azuresynapse.net.
_comments.synapse.auth: How the job logs in to Synapse; reuse the identity of the existing JDBC connection. One of: {"mode": "service_credential", "credential_name": <UC service credential>} (managed identity); {"mode": "client_secret", "secret_scope", "tenant_id_key", "client_id_key", "client_secret_key"} (service principal); {"mode": "sql_password", "secret_scope", "user_key", "password_key"} (SQL login). The *_key values are key names in the Databricks secret scope, not the secrets.
_comments.synapse.uc_jdbc_connection: Existing Unity Catalog JDBC connection to the pool (SHOW CONNECTIONS). Used only for the fallback read when CETAS cannot export a table. The package never creates it.
_comments.upstream.completion_source: Keep 'manifest': the daily row-count CSV plus its marker file is the 'upstream finished' signal. 4A refuses any other value.
_comments.manifest.path_template: Full abfss:// path of the daily row-count CSV. Must contain exactly one {business_date} (2026-10-12) or {business_date_compact} (20261012), so each day has its own file. Must be in a container other than staging.root, where the job can only read.
_comments.manifest.success_marker: File name of the marker written last, in the same folder as the CSV, e.g. _SUCCESS or _success_marker.json. Content: {"business_date": "2026-10-12", "upstream_run_id": "2026-10-12", "upstream_sequence": 2026101200}.
_comments.manifest.columns: Header names in the real CSV, mapped to what the job needs. Change only the right-hand values. upstream_sequence may be absent from the CSV (then yyyymmdd00 is used).
_comments.staging.root: Container where CETAS writes Parquet and the job reads it back. Must be covered by an existing external location with READ FILES and WRITE FILES for the job.
_comments.staging.prefix: Folder under staging.root for this job's files. Keep equal to the prefix in infra/adls_lifecycle_policy.json.
_comments.staging.metadata_schema: Synapse schema holding the temporary CETAS external tables.
_comments.staging.external_data_source: Existing Synapse external data source pointing at staging.root (SELECT name, location FROM sys.external_data_sources).
_comments.staging.file_format: Existing Synapse external file format; must be PARQUET.
_comments.control.catalog: Existing Unity Catalog catalog for the job's own log tables (run_log, table_log, plan). Not your business data.
_comments.control.schema: Schema for the log tables; created by the rendered uc_setup.sql. The runbook calls catalog.schema <ctl>.
_comments.notifications.summary_webhook: Where the nightly summary email is sent: secret_scope and url_secret_key name the Databricks secret holding the HTTPS webhook URL (e.g. an Azure Logic App). Never put the URL itself here.
_comments.execution.max_tables_per_batch: Most tables in one batch. Tables in a batch run one after another.
_comments.execution.max_bytes_per_batch: Most estimated source bytes in one batch (from --profile).
_comments.execution.export_timeout_seconds: Longest one table's export may run.
_comments.execution.cutoff_local_time: Publication deadline for the nightly run, local time. No table is published after it.
_comments.execution.recovery_cutoff_local_time: Last time a same-day manual rerun may publish. For daytime dev tests set it later in the dev inventory only.
_comments.execution.publish_margin_minutes: No new export or publish starts within this many minutes of the cutoff.
_comments.execution.cutoff_timezone: Time zone of the cutoffs and of the business date.
_comments.execution.history_limit: Delta history entries read when checking a target.
_comments.execution.upstream_wait_minutes: How long the plan waits for today's CSV and marker before failing the night.
_comments.execution.jdbc_fallback_enabled: Allow the UC-JDBC fallback when CETAS fails for a non-data, non-capacity reason.
_comments.execution.jdbc_fetch_size: Rows per JDBC fetch in the fallback.
_comments.execution.jdbc_num_partitions: Parallel JDBC reads per fallback table (needs jdbc_partition_column on the mapping). Worst case connections = export_concurrency x this.
_comments.execution.max_jdbc_fallbacks_per_batch: Most CETAS-error fallbacks allowed in one batch.
_comments.execution.fallback_alert_threshold: Finalize alerts when CETAS-error fallbacks in a night exceed this.
_comments.execution.additional_access_error_codes: Extra Synapse error numbers to treat as permission denied. Add only codes seen in a real failure.
_comments.execution.max_failed_table_ratio: Finalize fails the job when more than this share of planned tables did not refresh. Do not raise without evidence.
_comments.execution.plan_transient_retry_minutes: How long the plan retries temporary platform errors itself.
_comments.governance.exempt_abac_policies: Keep empty. Each entry is a reviewed human decision about one ABAC policy; see the runbook, 'Governed targets'.
_comments.table_properties: Delta properties set on newly created target tables. deletedFileRetentionDuration is the rollback window.
